NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public URL of this Langfuse deployment. Auto-resolves to https://<railway-domain> so OAuth callbacks and email links work out of the box.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Cryptographic key used to sign session cookies and JWTs. Auto-generated by Railway at deploy time; do not edit unless you intentionally want to invalidate every active session.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Auto-wired to the companion Postgres service via Railway private networking.

SALT.description: Salt used for hashing API keys. Auto-generated by Railway at deploy time.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 64-character hex key used to encrypt sensitive data at rest. Auto-generated by Railway at deploy time. Generate manually with: openssl rand -hex 32

CLICKHOUSE_URL.description: ClickHouse HTTP endpoint. Auto-wired to the companion ClickHouse service via Railway private networking.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse username. Must match the companion ClickHouse service's CLICKHOUSE_USER.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: ClickHouse password. Must match the companion ClickHouse service's CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis hostname. Auto-wired to the companion Redis service via Railway private networking.

REDIS_AUTH.description: Redis password. Must match the companion Redis service's REDIS_AUTH.

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT.description: MinIO S3 endpoint for event uploads. Auto-wired to the companion MinIO service via Railway private networking.

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT.description: MinIO S3 endpoint for media uploads. Auto-wired to the companion MinIO service via Railway private networking.

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: MinIO access key ID for event uploads. Must match the companion MinIO service's MINIO_ROOT_USER.

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_SECRET_ACCESS_K.description: MinIO secret access key for event uploads. Must match the companion MinIO service's MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: MinIO access key ID for media uploads. Must match the companion MinIO service's MINIO_ROOT_USER.

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_SECRET_ACCESS_K.description: MinIO secret access key for media uploads. Must match the companion MinIO service's MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.

TELEMETRY_ENABLED.description: Enable anonymous telemetry to help improve Langfuse. Set to 'false' to opt out.

LANGFUSE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES.description: Enable experimental features. Set to 'true' to try new features before they are stable.

POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Used by Langfuse to connect to the database.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL superuser password. Auto-generated by Railway at deploy time.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database name. Langfuse uses this database for all its data.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse username. Used by Langfuse to connect to ClickHouse.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: ClickHouse password. Auto-generated by Railway at deploy time.

REDIS_AUTH.description: Redis password. Used by Langfuse (BullMQ) to connect to Redis. Auto-generated by Railway at deploy time.

MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: MinIO root user / access key ID. Used by Langfuse to authenticate S3 requests.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: MinIO root password / secret access key. Auto-generated by Railway at deploy time.
